data.explanation: Your utility provider says two monthly advance payments (Abschläge) plus a small reminder fee are overdue, totalling €226.00. Pay this amount to the provider's account by 10 December 2026. If you don't pay, the letter says the provider may interrupt your electricity/water supply after giving you prior notice. If you believe the amounts are wrong or already paid, contact the provider directly using the contact details on the letter before the deadline.
